༄༅/ /rang lugs kyi rnga grangs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rang lugs kyi rnga grangs bzhugs so//

rang lugs kyi bskang gsol sogs rnga rdung byed dgos 'di tsho la yin na/ dang po bdag na so phra ba'i skabs su/ bskang gsol la sogs bzung nas gsar dad byed pa'i skabs/ skad med kyang gdangs dbyangs sogs la zhe 'dod kyi rtog 'jug zhib tu byas pa'i tshe dka' tshegs chen po rang dgos pa byung*/ deng sang ni gdangs dbyangs rnga chings slob mi dgos par rang chas su yong ba 'di 'dra ni nga la bsod nams med pas yong ma nyan/ de skabs tshad mar 'dzin pa la gtso bo zhabs drung nā ro pa/ bla ma rin po che mkhan po/ sku rim pa a khu rtsing ral ba/ bla ma dom gad pa phun tshogs bkra shis/ de rnams la rnga rdung lugs/ gdangs 'then lugs thams cad la bltas dris/ rtsad bcad mal sa tshun chad du 'og 'gyu btang byas pa yin pas/ de dus byed lugs ha lam tsam zhig bri na/ mgon po'i mtshams gcod kyi rnga 'di'ang*| deng sang gi sgog pa rdung stangs 'dra ba 'di mi gda'/ thog mar spyan 'dren sogs kyi chem rdung ltar mgo btsugs nas shin tu dal ba byed/ de cung zad che ba de'i mod nas sa sbub rdo sbub rang min par en tsam brel du btang pa'i mod la chung du btang*/ yang cher btang*/ yang chung du btang ba| de 'dra chem rdung che chung spel ma lnga byed/ de'i che chung re re'i rnga grangs la deng sang grangs bcad yod rgyu ba'i mkha' nyams 'di 'dra med/ che chung re re la bco lnga bcu gsum gang rung tsam byang 'dren rang gi 'dod bstun byed/ che chung spel ma lnga po rdzogs pa'i chung ba'i steng mtshams gcod kyi rnga len par lus ngag sems mar lan yod kyi sum rdung gsum byed/ de ring 'then thung 'then gnyis kar 'dra/ mtshams gcod gsum la lan yod nyis rdung gnyis re/ mtshams gcod gang yin yang tshar nas mtshams gcod pa'i 'don pa brel po rang min pa byas| de ka'i rnga dal brel dang bstun nas chem rdung blangs pa che chung spel ma lnga byas pa'i che ba'i steng nas rnga grangs gsum gyis 'jog pa yin/

deng sang mtshams gcod pa'i 'don pa brel po la/ de mus chem rdung len drab dal du gtong ba'i 'don pa dang rnga dal brel 'dzol ba 'di 'dra mi gda'/ de rjes bde mchog mgon po a phyi sogs kyi spyan 'dren chem rdung skabs/ deng sang gi rnga mgo dal po la glo bur du ba glang tshad chu rgyab pa'i mjug ma ltar glo bur du brel du gtong ba 'di 'dra mi byed/ dal po rim phab nas rnga shed kyang je cher gtong zhing*/ 'gying stabs yod pa 'dra'i ngang nas brel ba'i tshe rnga shed chung du btang nas/ slar dbyangs kyi rnga grangs gang yin len pa de kha yin/ 'jog mtshams thams cad du gsum gyis 'jog pa ma gtogs/ gcig gis 'jog pa lkugs pas phyen btang ba 'dra byed kyi mi 'dug /mgon po'i bstod pa nyis rdung lan yod gang yin gyi skabs/ bar skabs su bza' btung sogs byas nas slar len dus gdangs byed mi byed gang yin yang*/ bzhi rdung gcig dang*/ nyis rdung gnyis byed pa deng sang gang 'khor ma dang bskang ba'i mgor byed pa 'di 'dra ma gtogs med/ dpal bzhi ma'i rjes su bka' srung ha ra btang ba'i mthar mā ra ya che ba brdung*/ de la mā ra zhes pa lan gnyis la/ mā che ra chung ya che ba de rjes hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ de rjes bdun rdung gnyis byed/ yang mā ra ya gnyis/ hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ bdun rdung gnyis/ mā ra ya gnyis/ hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ dgu rdung gcig dang*/ bdun rdung gnyis/ yang mā ra ya gnyis| hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ dgu rdung gcig /bdun rdung gnyis kyi bdun phyi ma'i rjes la mā ra ya gnyis/ hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ chung ba gcig rgyab rjes 'theng rdung je brel la btang nas sib 'jog dus mtshams rtsa'i rnga ltar che ba gcig rgyab rjes thig thig zer ba don du mtshams rtsa'i rnga ltar gcig gnyis gsum bzhi zhes brel btud tsam nas che ba gcig rgyab pa de 'dra lan gsum byas nas 'jog /sbub sil kha 'thab ring rnga rnams thig thig de 'dra gsum dang kha 'thab thig thig med pa gcig rgyab nas 'jog

/'jog lugs 'di rnga chings thams cad la byed/ deng sang gsum dang gcig gis 'jog pa 'di de dus ma shes 'dug /mgon po'i gzhung la sbub chal btsan 'jug ma gtogs 'drud mi rgyag /dpal bzhi ma phyin bskang bran thams cad la 'drud rgyag la/ a phyi'i rjes su zhi lu drag rdung byed pa la gcig nas dgu'i bar dal ba gcig dgu mi brtsegs/ de rjes brel ba che ba gsum/ 'bring ba gsum/ chung ba gsum dang dgu| yang bdun cung dal ba gcig /brel ba che ba gnyis/ 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gsum dang bdun/ de nas dal ba lnga rdung gcig /brel ba lnga rdung che ba gcig /'bring ba sbub ༄༅/ /gcig /chung ba gsum dang lnga/ de rjes gsum rdung dal ba gcig /brel ba gsum rdung*/ che ba gcig /'bring ba gcig /chung ba gcig dang gsum 'di'i dal brel gyi mtshams rnga lcags gcig gi yun tsam ma gtogs deng sang rgyu ma lug pa 'dra ba 'di mi byed/ tha ma 'theng rdung sogs sngar mā ra ya'i rjes kyi de ka dang khyad med/ de rjes zhing skyong gi bstod pa'i rjes sogs la mā ra ya chung ba brdung ba la/ mā ra ya gnyis sngar ltar che chung yod tsam gyi rjes su hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis/ bdun rdung khol rang tshub be ba bzhi dang*/ mā ra ya gnyis hūm̐ phaṭa gnyis 'theng rdung sogs rjes gong bzhin no// zhing skyong gi rjes su dgu rdung che ba 'bab/ de bzhi rdung ni gcig dang bzhi che ba gnyis dang gsum chung tsam byas pa lan bzhi'i rjes su dgu rdung dgu byed pa che chung spel lugs sngar zhi lu drag rdung dang 'dra/ yang 'dir dgu dgu zhes rtsag /yang bzhi rdung bzhi dang bdun rdung bdun/ yang bzhi rdung bzhi dang lnga rdung lnga/ yang bzhi rdung bzhi dang gsum rdung gsum rnams byed pa'i che chung spel lugs sngar zhi lu drag rdung dang 'dra/ bdun lnga gsum po'i rjes la'ang dgu ltar bdun bdun lnga lnga/ gsum gsum zhes brtsegs pa yin/ mthar chung ba gcig dang 'theng rdung sogs 'jog lugs mā ra ya che ba'i skabs dang 'dra/

yang khyab 'jug dang chos skyong mi sbrel na khyab 'jug gi rjes su mā ra ya chung ba byed pa'ang yod/ chos skyong spyan 'dren sib rdung gi rjes la lan byas/ mthar nyis rdung gcig dang gsum rdung gcig gi rjes su bzhi rdung ni gcig dang bzhi che gnyis gsum chung ba ji ltar rigs pa che ba nas chung bar rim par phab pa 'di la grangs med/ chung ba'i mthar dgu rdung gcig gi mthar dgu dgu dgu/ yang bzhi rdung che chung spel mthar dgu brtsegs pa gong ltar/ de rjes bzhi rdung che chung spel mthar sgrog 'gros che chung spel/ che chung spel zhes pa don du 'theng rdung rgyob sod ltar las 'cham gyi rnga ni ma yin no/ mchan/ de rjes gong ltar dgu ༄༅/ /brtsegs de 'dra lan gnyis byas pa'i dgu tha mar che ba gcig rgyab/ slar 'theng rdung gi sib rjes spyan 'dren dbyangs kyi rnga len/ gang zhig yid dran ma lan gsum gdangs byas rjes dgu rdung chung ba ni/ sngar dgu rdung che ba'i skabs ltar bzhi rdung che chung yod pa bzhi byas rjes/ dgu rdung che ba gcig la dgu dgu brtsegs pa/ gsum dang chung ba gcig 'theng rdung sogs 'jog lugs sngar ltar bya/ yang na mā ra ya che ba dang*/ zhi lu drag rdung dgu rdung che ba rnams 'jog lugs 'cham rtsa'i rnga ltar byed/ mā ra ya chung ba dang*/ dgu rdung chung ba gnyis la 'theng rdung gi mthar gsum rang gis 'jog pa yang skabs skabs byed/ thun gtor gyi rjes su gdangs dal brel gang byas de ka'i mus la bcar nas chem rdung che chung spel ma lnga byas pa'i tha mar che ba'i mthar rnga dal po bzhis 'jog pa yin/ mtshams gcod thun gtor gyi chem rdung mgon po dang bka' brgyad khyad med/ deng sang nyi shu rtsa bzhi ma la sgar chen gshar gdangs yin zer ba zhig byed 'dug pa 'di sgar chen kar lugs kyi de dang ni mi 'dra ba 'dug /gzhan sgar chen su'i yin ma shes byung*/ a phyi'i chad mdo sogs dgu rdung gi gdangs 'di la dgu rdung brtsegs dus deng sang che chung chen po byed pa grogs ma'i rked pa 'dra ba 'di mi byed/

che chung yod tsam las 'theng rdung yod tsam zhig byed pa yin/ lhag par gdangs dbyangs 'then pa'i dus dang shar 'don byed skabs/ deng sang gtsang bro pa'i rnga ltar che zhing drag pa 'khrab ci nus byed pa 'di 'dra med/ sbub sil dang sgrig dus ma gtogs 'don pa'i skabs gdangs shar gang la yang rnga shed chung chung rang byed pa la gtsor 'don byed pa zhig 'dug pa yin no// yang deng sang*/ sbub sil kha rdeb shes pa kho na sbub sil shes zer ba dang*/ sbub chal kha 'thab ma bcug par sbub chal gtsang zer ba 'di 'dra mi byed spub sil grangs chad lhag ma byung ba la nges par zer/ che sar che chung sar chung ba la gtsang zer/ rnga mang nyung dang bstun pa'i sbub sil skad thon pa de'ang sbub chal kha mnyam sgrig dang gyen slang rang min pa/ zla tshes thon tsam la nyal slang ran pa dang*/ sil snyan skya ga'i mjug rdeb lta bu min pa/ gyen slang g.yon 'gul 'khyil 'khyil ba la sil snyan rdung shes zer gyi 'dug pa yin no// zhes dan pa dang chos mdzad gad tshas bris zer bas/ sngags rgan gyis bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
